items.description:
Macsteel Trading in Superbia is a branch of Macsteel, a steel group with roots going back more than a century and a network of over forty service centres and processing branches spread across South Africa. It supplies structural steel, tube, pipe, sheet and related products to builders, fabricators, farmers and industrial customers, drawing on the group's buying power to keep a wide range of grades and sizes in stock for same-day collection.

The Superbia branch, on Sapphire Street, serves contractors and manufacturers across Polokwane and the surrounding Limpopo region, cutting and preparing steel to order where needed. Being part of a large national supplier means customers can usually get material that a small local yard would have to order in, while still buying it over a counter close to home.

Limpopo Cash & Carry is a wholesale and general-dealer outlet trading in Superbia, stocking a broad range of groceries, cleaning products and household basics for both retailers and everyday shoppers. Buying in bulk from a cash-and-carry outlet like this one typically works out cheaper per unit than a standard supermarket, which is why small shop owners, caterers and larger families are drawn to this kind of store, and why no minimum purchase is required to shop here.

From its premises on Mangaan Street, the business serves customers from Superbia and further afield across the province, functioning as a supply point for smaller retailers restocking their own shelves as much as for households doing a big monthly shop. The emphasis throughout is on volume and value rather than a curated or boutique shopping experience.

All Car Customs is a vehicle customisation workshop in Annadale specialising in car audio and security installations, fitting recognised brands such as Rockford Fosgate, Lightning Audio and MB Quart sound systems into customers' vehicles. Beyond audio work, the business also handles air conditioning, bull bars, tow bars, roll bars and in-car entertainment systems, giving owners looking to upgrade or protect a vehicle several options under one roof rather than just a repair.

Operating from Pietersburg Street, the workshop draws customers from across Polokwane who want factory-standard fitment rather than a makeshift job, since poorly installed audio or towing equipment can affect both performance and resale value. The mix of comfort, security and entertainment upgrades in one place suits owners wanting several changes done in a single visit.

Dros Polokwane (Thornhill) is a branch of Dros, a well-known South African family restaurant chain built around generous portions and a relaxed, pub-style dining room. The Thornhill branch follows the same wide menu as other Dros restaurants, serving steaks, seafood, pasta, burgers, pizzas and grills alongside a full bar, making it a practical choice for a family dinner, a casual date or a group of friends after work.

The restaurant trades inside Thornhill Shopping Centre on the corner of Veldspaat and Munnik Avenue, giving diners easy parking and other shops nearby before or after a meal. As part of a chain found in towns across the country, it offers the predictability of a familiar menu with the convenience of a Polokwane location close to home.

Ligthelm Accountants is a chartered accounting practice based in Moregloed, handling the day-to-day bookkeeping, tax and financial accounting work that small and medium businesses and individual taxpayers need to stay compliant. A practice of this kind typically prepares annual financial statements, manages SARS submissions and advises clients on structuring their affairs efficiently, rather than only stepping in once a year at tax time.

The firm operates from Kleinenberg Street, putting it within reach of businesses and households across Polokwane who want a local accountant rather than a call centre. For many clients, having an accounting firm nearby makes it easier to drop off paperwork, sit down and go through numbers in person, and build a working relationship over several tax years rather than starting from scratch each season.

I D Studio Photos and Photocopies is a photography studio and copy shop based in Moregloed, offering both photographic services and document photocopying from the same premises. Pairing photography with photocopying under one roof is a practical combination for a neighbourhood studio, letting the business serve portrait and event photography clients as well as people who simply need documents copied or printed.

The studio trades from Library Gardens on Grobler Street, placing it within reach of other Polokwane Central businesses and making it a convenient stop for residents running errands in the area. Listed in local business directories as a photography specialist, it continues to serve the Moregloed and wider Polokwane Central community with both its camera work and its everyday copying services.

Meat World The Greenery is a butchery trading under the Meat World brand, a South African chain known for selling fresh meat, boerewors and braai packs at competitive prices alongside basic grocery lines. Shops like this typically focus on volume and value, cutting and packing meat for family meals and gatherings rather than offering a specialist or gourmet selection.

The branch trades inside The Greenery shopping centre in Polokwane Central, on the corner of Grobler and Oost Street, alongside anchor tenants such as Checkers, Woolworths and Clicks. Being part of a larger retail centre means shoppers can combine a meat run with the rest of their weekly groceries, making it a convenient stop for households restocking the freezer in one visit.

Seshego Hospital is a public district hospital serving Seshego and the surrounding communities, providing the kind of care typical of a district-level facility: inpatient wards, outpatient consultations, maternity and antenatal services, and ongoing management of chronic conditions such as TB and HIV. As a government hospital, it forms part of the public healthcare network that residents without private medical aid rely on for both emergency and routine treatment.

Located on Bo-Okelo Street in Seshego-A, the hospital serves as a key healthcare point for the wider Seshego area northwest of Polokwane, handling cases that smaller clinics are not equipped to manage. For many families in the area, it is the nearest facility offering overnight care, surgical referral and specialist outpatient follow-up rather than only first-line primary healthcare.

Patong Guest Lodge is a guest lodge in Lebowakgomo offering a range of air-conditioned rooms, from twin and double units to queen en-suite options, aimed at both overnight travellers and longer-staying guests. A swimming pool and free Wi-Fi are available on site, along with conference and event facilities for meetings, functions and garden weddings, giving it a dual role as both a place to sleep and a venue for gatherings.

Set on Main Street in Zone F, the lodge also runs a restaurant, bar and lapa, so guests and visitors attending an event do not need to travel elsewhere to eat or socialise. That combination of accommodation, dining and function space makes it a practical base for business travellers passing through Lebowakgomo as well as families organising a celebration.

Calculus Accountants is an accounting practice in Polokwane Central offering a broad spread of services that go beyond simple bookkeeping, including tax and VAT administration, payroll processing, estate planning, business strategy advice and accounting support tailored to agricultural clients. That range suits a farming region like Limpopo, where a single practice often needs to serve both town-based businesses and surrounding agricultural operations.

The practice is based on Biccard Street, giving it a central location for clients travelling in from across Polokwane and the wider district. Offering estate planning and strategic business advice alongside the usual tax and payroll work means clients can turn to one firm for both immediate compliance needs and longer-term financial planning, rather than engaging several specialists separately.

Elizabeth Manning Physiotherapy is an outpatient physiotherapy practice in Bendor treating musculoskeletal, sports, chest and neurological conditions from fully equipped treatment rooms. Physiotherapy of this kind typically combines hands-on treatment, exercise rehabilitation and advice on managing an injury day to day, whether a patient is recovering from surgery, nursing a sports injury or managing a long-term chest or nerve condition.

The practice also runs Pilates classes on site, giving patients and other clients a way to build strength and mobility between physiotherapy sessions. Based on Outspan Drive, it serves patients from Bendor and the surrounding Polokwane suburbs who need ongoing, hands-on rehabilitation rather than a once-off consultation, often working alongside referring doctors and specialists.

Roman's Pizza (The Crossing) is a branch of the Roman's Pizza franchise, a long-running South African pizza chain built on fresh dough made in store and a menu designed for quick takeaway and delivery rather than sit-down dining. Customers can choose between pan and traditional crusts, along with pizza pies, pasta, garlic bread and salads, making it a straightforward option for a family dinner or a quick meal on the go.

The outlet trades from The Crossing Shopping Centre on the corner of Grobler and Grimm Street in Fauna Park, sharing the centre's parking with its other tenants. As with other Roman's Pizza branches around the country, the appeal lies in a familiar, affordable menu backed by a national brand, delivered from a convenient neighbourhood location.

Steers Total Fauna Park is a branch of Steers, the South African flame-grilled burger chain recognised for cooking its patties over open flame rather than on a flat grill. The Fauna Park outlet follows the usual Steers format, serving burgers, chicken and ribs for takeaway and drive-through customers who want a quick meal without getting out of the car.

Situated at the TotalEnergies fuel station on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki Street, the outlet benefits from forecourt traffic, catching drivers refuelling as well as diners making a dedicated stop. Pairing a fast-food brand with a petrol station is a common format in South Africa, letting motorists combine a fuel stop with a meal on longer trips through Polokwane.

Tuscan Place Restaurant is an Italian-styled eatery in Penina Park built around a rustic decor and a garden setting rather than a standard shopping-centre dining room. The menu runs to grilled meats, salads and desserts, served alongside a cocktail bar, giving diners the option of a full meal or just drinks and something light.

A garden patio and playground make the venue suited to family outings as much as evenings out, while live music and catering for group bookings extend its role to functions and celebrations. Based on Kerk Street, the restaurant gives residents of Penina Park and the surrounding Polokwane suburbs a sit-down option with more atmosphere than a typical fast-food outlet, geared toward lingering over a meal rather than a quick takeaway.

Ngwanesho Guest House, in Unit B, Lebowakgomo, offers simple accommodation built around single and double rooms, each with a private shower and DStv for guests who want their own space without hotel-style extras. A communal kitchen and dining area give guests the option to prepare their own meals rather than relying on an on-site restaurant, which suits longer stays or travellers watching their budget.

Secure parking is provided for guests arriving by car, a practical feature in a township setting where off-street parking is not always guaranteed. The guest house serves travellers and visiting family passing through Lebowakgomo, offering a no-frills, affordable base rather than a full-service hotel experience.

P and L Hardware in Lebowakgomo is a branch of a hardware wholesaler and retailer that has supplied the building trade since 1982, stocking the building materials, tools and fittings that both contractors and home builders need for day-to-day projects. Operating next to Cashbuild at the Metro T Junction puts it alongside another major building-materials retailer, giving customers a choice of suppliers in one trip.

The branch focuses on rural and township markets around Lebowakgomo, where access to a well-stocked hardware store can mean a long drive if the local option runs short. Decades of trading in the hardware sector suggest a business that has adapted its stock to what builders in the area actually need, rather than a generic, one-size-fits-all range.

Boxer Superstores runs a discount supermarket at Metlife Plaza in Lebowakgomo, part of a nationwide chain known for stretching value further through bulk buying and no-frills store formats rather than a premium shopping experience. Shelves are stocked with groceries, household essentials and everyday goods aimed squarely at budget-conscious shoppers doing a weekly or monthly family shop.

Trading from Shop 14 on Main Road, the store benefits from its position inside Metlife Plaza, drawing shoppers already visiting the centre for banking or other errands. For many households in and around Lebowakgomo, a Boxer store is the practical choice for stretching a grocery budget, offering lower prices in exchange for a simpler, more basic shopping environment than a full-service supermarket.

Absa Bank operates a full-service branch inside Metlife Plaza in Lebowakgomo, part of one of South Africa's largest banking groups with a branch network spanning towns and cities across the country. Customers can open and manage accounts, apply for cards and loans, and handle everyday transactions in person rather than only through digital channels.

The branch sits at the corner of Orrie Baragwanath Pass and Jane Furse Road, making it a convenient banking point for residents and businesses in Lebowakgomo who would otherwise have to travel further into Polokwane for in-branch service. Having a major bank represented inside a local shopping centre also means banking can be combined with other errands on a single trip to the plaza.

MTN Store at Checkers Centre is a retail outlet of MTN, one of South Africa's largest mobile network operators, selling handsets, SIM cards, airtime and data bundles to walk-in customers. Staff at a branded store like this typically also help with account queries, device troubleshooting and upgrades, giving customers a physical point of contact beyond a call centre or app.

The store trades on Hans Van Rensburg Street inside Checkers Centre in Polokwane Central, putting it within easy reach of shoppers already in the centre for groceries or banking. For customers who prefer sorting out a new contract or a faulty phone face to face, a dedicated MTN store offers a more hands-on alternative to buying airtime from a general retailer.

House of Vallerie is a bed and breakfast in Bendor offering double rooms equipped with a hairdryer, fridge, kettle and ironing facilities, the kind of self-catering touches that suit both business travellers and leisure guests wanting some independence from a full hotel service. Guest parking is provided on site, removing one of the usual worries for visitors unfamiliar with the area.

An outdoor garden seating area gives guests a quiet spot to relax away from their room, whether that means an early coffee or an evening unwinding after a day of meetings or sightseeing. Based on Munnik Avenue, the bed and breakfast serves visitors to Bendor and the wider Polokwane area looking for a smaller, more personal alternative to a chain hotel.

Oasis Water Platinum Park is an outlet of Oasis Water, a South African franchise chain specialising in purified drinking water and the equipment used to treat it. Customers can refill water containers on site or buy water treatment units for home use, an alternative to bottled water that many households and offices in the region rely on for everyday drinking water.

Trading from inside Platinum Park shopping centre in Bendor Park, the outlet is positioned alongside other centre tenants, making a water refill an easy addition to a regular shopping trip rather than a special errand. As part of a franchise found in shopping centres across the country, it offers a consistent, locally accessible source of treated water for the Bendor Park area.

Nirvana Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy on Tungsten Street dispensing prescription medicines alongside everyday health and wellness products such as vitamins, skincare and over-the-counter remedies. A neighbourhood pharmacy of this kind typically also offers basic health advice over the counter, giving residents a quicker option than a doctor's appointment for minor ailments.

Serving the Nirvana suburb and surrounding parts of Polokwane, the pharmacy functions as a local alternative to the larger pharmacy chains found in shopping centres further from the area. For residents managing repeat prescriptions or simply picking up everyday health products, having a pharmacy within the suburb itself cuts out an unnecessary trip into town.

Tip Top Wholesalers is a wholesale and retail outlet in Superbia stocking a notably wide mix of goods, from blankets, fabrics and foam mattresses to footwear, schoolwear, enamelware, catering equipment and stationery. That spread of stock suits both households doing a bulk shop and smaller traders restocking for resale, letting a single visit cover several different shopping needs at once.

Trading from Nikkel Street, the business serves Superbia and the wider Polokwane area as a value-focused alternative to buying the same items individually from several specialist shops. Carrying everything from bedding to catering supplies under one roof is typical of an established general wholesaler aimed at keeping costs down for customers buying in quantity.

Magnolia Guest House is a self-catering guest house in Eduan Park offering several different unit types, from a smaller budget room through to a garden apartment and a larger unit able to sleep up to seven guests. That range of options suits everything from a solo traveller on a tight budget to an extended family or group needing space under one roof.

Based on Snyman Street, the guest house gives visitors to Eduan Park and the surrounding Polokwane suburbs the flexibility of self-catering, with guests able to prepare their own meals rather than relying on an on-site restaurant. The mix of unit sizes makes it a practical choice for longer stays, family visits or small group trips where a standard single hotel room would not be enough.

Choppies Seshego Plaza is a supermarket branch of Choppies, a retail chain that began in Botswana and has expanded into several southern African countries including South Africa, built around stocking everyday groceries at accessible prices. The Seshego branch carries a standard supermarket range of fresh produce, packaged groceries and household goods for the surrounding community.

Trading from Main Road inside Seshego Plaza, the store gives Seshego residents a full grocery shop without needing to travel into central Polokwane. As part of an international retail chain with a growing footprint in the region, the branch offers the buying power of a larger group while still serving as a straightforward, everyday local supermarket for the township.

Wackys Polokwane CBD is a fried chicken and wings takeaway on Excelsior Street in Polokwane Central, built around quick-service meals rather than sit-down dining. The menu centres on fried chicken and wings, the kind of casual, shareable food that suits a quick lunch, a late-night order or a meal picked up on the way home.

Customers can collect orders in store or have them delivered through third-party delivery apps, giving the business reach well beyond people walking past its Excelsior Street premises. That combination of walk-in collection and app-based delivery has become typical of smaller independent takeaway outlets competing with larger fast-food chains in central Polokwane.

Moldovanos Swanepoel & Schoeman Optometrists is an optometry practice on Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, affiliated with the Vision Works network of independent optometrists found across South Africa. Services include full eye examinations, contact lens fittings and the vision tests required for a driver's licence, covering both general eye health and the practical paperwork many patients need.

Being part of a wider optometry network while remaining locally run gives the practice access to resources and buying power beyond what a fully independent practice might have, without losing the personal service of a local optometrist. The practice serves patients across Polokwane Central needing anything from a routine eye test to ongoing management of a vision condition.

Renove Aesthetics & Wellness Clinic is a skin and body aesthetics clinic in Bendor Park offering treatments such as microneedling and dermal fillers alongside more everyday beauty services like manicures and eyebrow shaping. That combination of clinical and beauty treatments under one roof lets clients book a single appointment for several different concerns rather than visiting separate specialists.

Trading from Platinum Park shopping centre, the clinic benefits from the centre's foot traffic and shared parking, making it an easy stop for clients already visiting other shops nearby. Clinics of this type have grown common in South African shopping centres as demand for accessible, non-surgical skin and body treatments has increased, and this one serves the Bendor Park and wider Polokwane area.

Roman's Pizza Platinum Park is another branch of the national Roman's Pizza franchise, serving the same core menu of pan and traditional-crust pizzas found at Roman's outlets throughout South Africa. Pasta, pizza pies, garlic bread and salads round out the menu, with dough prepared fresh on site each day rather than brought in pre-made.

The outlet trades from Platinum Park shopping centre in Bendor Park, giving customers in that part of Polokwane a nearby takeaway option without having to cross town to one of the chain's other branches. Fresh daily dough-making is a standard practice across Roman's Pizza stores and remains one of the brand's selling points even at a smaller neighbourhood outlet like this one.

Lipo Slimming Clinic is a body-contouring and weight-loss clinic in Fauna Park offering treatments such as body sculpting and laser lipo alongside a structured weight-loss programme for clients working toward longer-term results rather than a single quick fix. Combining in-clinic treatments with an ongoing programme is a common approach in the slimming industry, giving clients both immediate visual changes and a plan to maintain them.

Based on Marabou Avenue, the clinic serves clients from Fauna Park and the broader Polokwane area seeking non-surgical options for body shaping. For many clients, a local clinic offering this kind of treatment removes the need to travel to a larger centre or a private hospital for similar, though typically more invasive and costly, cosmetic procedures.

Polokwane Sheet Metal Works is a family-run steel fabrication business in Superbia that has spent over a decade building SABS-approved trailers, van bodies and truck low-beds for commercial and private customers. Working to SABS specifications matters for fabricated vehicles and trailers, since it signals that the finished product meets recognised national safety and construction standards rather than being built informally.

Operating from Graniet Street, the workshop serves transport operators, farmers and private buyers across Polokwane who need custom steel bodywork rather than an off-the-shelf unit. Being family-run over more than ten years suggests a business built on repeat customers and word of mouth within the local transport and farming community, rather than one-off sales to passing trade.

Discount Shelving - Buyers & Sellers is a shop-fitting business in Superbia that both buys and sells new and used shelving, racking and retail display equipment, sourcing stock from closed-down or refurbished stores across South Africa. That buy-and-sell model lets the business offer lower prices on used equipment while also taking old shelving off the hands of businesses that are closing or revamping.

Trading from Tungsten Street, the business serves retailers, warehouses and small shop owners across Polokwane who are setting up or re-fitting a space without the cost of brand-new fixtures. For a new or small retailer working to a tight budget, buying second-hand shop fittings from a specialist like this is often a more affordable route than ordering everything new.

Med-Express Pharmacy is an independently owned pharmacy on Grobler Street in Moregloed, dispensing both prescription medicines and over-the-counter products to residents of the surrounding community. Being independently owned, rather than part of a large retail chain, often means a closer working relationship between the pharmacist and regular patients managing ongoing prescriptions.

The pharmacy's Suite 1 premises put it within easy reach of Moregloed and nearby Polokwane Central, serving as a local alternative to pharmacies attached to larger supermarkets or shopping malls further away. For residents who prefer dealing with the same pharmacist over repeat visits, a smaller independent pharmacy like this can offer more continuity of care than a high-turnover chain branch.

Galito's Library Gardens is a branch of Galito's, a South African chain built around flame-grilled peri-peri chicken served with a choice of signature sauces and heat levels. The Moregloed branch follows the same format found at other Galito's outlets, serving chicken, burgers and sides for both eat-in and takeaway customers.

The restaurant trades from the Library Gardens Building on the corner of Schoeman and Grobler Street, putting it in easy reach of other businesses in Polokwane Central. As with other branches of the chain, the draw is a consistent, well-known flavour profile backed by a national brand, served from a location convenient for office workers and residents in the Moregloed area.

Lebowa Funeral Parlour Seshego is a funeral home that has served the Seshego community since 1976, handling burial and cremation arrangements as well as exhumation and reburial services for families needing to relocate a grave. Decades of continuous trading in such a sensitive line of work point to a business that has built trust across generations of local families.

Beyond the funeral arrangements themselves, the business also manufactures and installs tombstones and plaques, caters funeral gatherings and offers funeral policies, covering most of what a grieving family needs from one provider. Based in the Industrial Site in Zone 6, it continues to serve Seshego and the surrounding Polokwane area with a full range of funeral-related services under one roof.

FNB Polokwane is a branch of First National Bank, one of South Africa's major banking groups, offering the everyday banking, account and loan services expected of a full-service branch. Customers can open accounts, apply for credit, and handle routine transactions face to face, in addition to the bank's digital and telephone banking channels.

The branch sits at the corner of Thabo Mbeki Street and Landdros Mare Street, a central location in Polokwane's central business district that puts it within walking distance of other banks, government offices and retail businesses. For customers and businesses based in the CBD, having a major bank branch in this location means in-person banking does not require a trip out to a suburban shopping centre.

Doppio Zero Polokwane is a branch of the Doppio Zero chain, a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant and bakery concept found in shopping centres and lifestyle precincts across South Africa. The Bendor branch includes a wood-fired oven and an on-site bakery producing fresh bread and pastries, alongside a full restaurant menu for breakfast, lunch and dinner service.

Set at Farmyard Trading Post on the corner of Munich and Schools Road, the restaurant offers relaxed outdoor seating, a kids menu and wheelchair-accessible facilities, making it suited to families as much as couples or groups of friends. As part of a chain known for its bakery element, the Bendor branch gives Polokwane diners the same combination of casual dining and fresh-baked goods found at Doppio Zero restaurants elsewhere in the country.

Real Health Pharmacy Platinum Park is a branch of the Real Health Pharmacy group, a South African pharmacy network offering prescription dispensing alongside everyday health, wellness and personal-care products. Shop 8 in the centre gives the pharmacy a visible, easy-to-find position for shoppers combining a pharmacy visit with other errands.

Trading from Platinum Park Shopping Centre in Bendor Park, the branch serves residents collecting repeat prescriptions as well as shoppers picking up everyday medicines and health products while they are already in the centre. Being part of a wider pharmacy network means the branch can draw on group buying and stock support while still functioning as a convenient, local pharmacy counter for the Bendor Park area.

Fine And Country /Ansie Marais Properties is a real estate agency trading under the Fine & Country brand, an international franchise network that focuses on marketing higher-value residential property, operating from Cycad Centre in Bendor Park. The agency lists homes for sale across the greater Polokwane area, including properties in retirement and lifestyle estates such as Macadamia Lifestyle Estate.

Operating under an internationally recognised property brand while being locally run gives the agency access to wider marketing reach for sellers alongside the local market knowledge that comes from working the Polokwane area day to day. Buyers and sellers dealing with the agency can expect the kind of presentation-focused marketing the Fine & Country brand is known for, applied to homes and estates in and around Bendor Park.

Maruma Plant Hire is a heavy-machinery hire business in Ladanna, supplying forklifts, TLBs, tippers, cranes, lowbeds, graders, trucks, bobcats, rollers and excavators to construction and earthmoving projects around Polokwane. Hiring rather than buying this kind of equipment lets smaller contractors and developers take on bigger jobs without the capital cost of owning a full machinery fleet themselves.

Operating from Bulawayo Street, the business serves building contractors, civil works teams and farmers needing heavy equipment for a defined project or season rather than year-round use. Offering such a wide spread of machine types under one supplier means customers can often hire everything a site needs from a single contact rather than dealing with several separate plant-hire companies.

Sammy's Auto Spares & Repairs is an auto parts and vehicle repair workshop in Superbia, combining a spares counter with a mechanical workshop under one roof. That pairing lets the business both supply the part a customer needs and fit it on site, rather than sending motorists elsewhere once a part has been bought.

Based on Nikkel Street, the business serves motorists across Polokwane needing anything from a replacement part to a full mechanical repair, a useful combination for drivers who would otherwise have to visit a parts shop and a separate workshop. For budget-conscious car owners, having spares and repairs handled by the same business can also mean more flexibility on using second-hand or reconditioned parts where appropriate.

Rolter's Guest House is a 10-room guesthouse in Annadale offering rooms with flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms, set within grounds that include a garden, an outdoor pool and braai facilities for guests who want more than just a place to sleep. Daily housekeeping is included, giving the stay a hotel-style level of service despite the smaller, more personal scale of the property.

Free self parking rounds out the practical side of a stay, a detail that matters for guests arriving by car from elsewhere in Limpopo or further afield. Based on Doornkraal Street, the guesthouse serves travellers and visiting family looking for a mid-sized, garden-style property in Annadale rather than either a large hotel or a very small single-room bed and breakfast.

ATB Chartered Accountants is a full-service chartered accounting firm in Eduan Park offering bookkeeping, financial statement preparation, tax planning and audit and assurance services to a mix of businesses, individuals, trusts and non-profit organisations. Covering audit work alongside standard bookkeeping and tax services means the firm can serve clients with more complex compliance needs, not only straightforward personal tax returns.

Based on Harley Street, the firm serves clients across Polokwane and the surrounding area who need a registered chartered accountant for anything from routine tax filing to a formal statutory audit. Working with trusts and non-profits alongside standard business clients points to a practice with experience across a fairly wide range of accounting and compliance work rather than one narrow specialism.

Zone 4 Motel and Spa is a 20-room motel in Seshego Zone 4 offering free Wi-Fi, free private parking and a garden terrace for guests, alongside an on-site spa providing massages and aromatherapy treatments. Combining overnight accommodation with spa services gives guests the option of treating a stay as a short getaway rather than simply a place to sleep.

Based on Moretloa Avenue in Seshego-D, the motel serves travellers passing through Seshego as well as local residents looking for a nearby spa treatment without needing to stay overnight. For visitors to Polokwane's western townships, a motel of this size offering both rooms and wellness treatments fills a gap between a large hotel and a basic overnight stop.

Sasol Turfloop is a fuel station on the R71 at Ga Thoka, Mankweng, trading under the Sasol brand, one of the major fuel retailers found along routes throughout South Africa. The station operates around the clock, offering petrol and diesel alongside a bakery, coffee shop and convenience store for travellers wanting more than just a fuel stop.

Sitting on a well-travelled route near the University of Limpopo's Turfloop campus, the station serves both long-distance travellers passing through Mankweng and local residents and students needing fuel, snacks or a quick coffee at any hour. The round-the-clock trading hours and the mix of forecourt services make it a practical stop for anyone moving through the area outside normal business hours.

P and L Hardware Mankweng is a hardware store on Stand 16 supplying building materials to the Mankweng area, offering services beyond a simple retail counter, including free local delivery, glass cutting, and plan reading and costing for building projects. That last service, helping customers work out materials and costs from a building plan, is particularly useful for homeowners managing their own construction rather than working through a contractor.

Serving Mankweng and the surrounding communities near the University of Limpopo, the store functions as a practical, full-service option for both tradespeople and homeowners taking on renovation or new-build projects. Offering plan costing alongside the usual hardware stock sets it apart from a store that only sells materials over the counter without any technical support.

Maswika Consulting Engineers is a civil engineering consultancy in Welgelegen, founded in 2008, offering design, construction supervision and project management services for civil infrastructure such as roads, water systems and structural works. Clients range across both the public and private sector, reflecting the broad scope of work a civil engineering practice typically takes on in a regional centre like Polokwane.

Based on General Beyers Street, the consultancy serves government departments, municipalities and private developers needing technical oversight on infrastructure projects across Limpopo. Having been active since 2008, the firm has built up experience across multiple infrastructure categories rather than focusing on a single type of civil project, which suits clients needing one consultant across the design and construction phases of a project.

Pule Incorporated is a black-owned law firm founded in 1995, with offices in Johannesburg, Tshwane, Polokwane and Thohoyandou, providing legal services to both corporate and private clients. Operating across four centres gives the firm reach beyond a single-office practice, useful for clients with legal matters spanning more than one part of the country.

The Polokwane office trades from Suite 7 in the Concillium Building on General Beyers Street in Welgelegen, serving clients across Limpopo who need access to a multi-office firm without having to instruct separate attorneys in each city. Three decades of continuous operation since 1995 point to an established practice rather than a recently formed one, with the kind of institutional experience that comes from decades of corporate and private legal work.

Engen Nirvana Filling Station is a branch of Engen, one of South Africa's major fuel brands, trading around the clock from The Crescent Drive in Nirvana. Round-the-clock forecourt service means motorists in Polokwane North can refuel at any hour, not only during standard shopping or business hours.

Serving the surrounding Nirvana suburb and nearby parts of Polokwane North, the station functions as a dependable fuel point for residents' daily routines as well as travellers passing through the area at odd hours. Being part of a major national fuel brand also means a consistent fuel standard and forecourt experience, whether a driver is filling up here or at another Engen station elsewhere in the country.

Mighty Scrapyard cc has been trading in Ladanna since 2001, stripping and selling new and second-hand vehicle spares, with a particular focus on engines, gearboxes and diffs for VW, Toyota, Nissan and Ford models. Buying second-hand parts from a scrapyard like this is typically a cheaper route for motorists than sourcing new parts, especially for older vehicles no longer well supported by dealerships.

Based on Blaauwberg Street, the business also offers vehicle towing and recovery, giving it a role beyond parts sales for motorists stranded after a breakdown or accident. As an RMI member and an insurance-approved supplier, it operates within recognised industry standards, a detail that matters to insurers and to customers wanting assurance that a scrapyard is operating to proper standards rather than informally.
